scope: Nine complete original activity-card texts, wording review only; no child-use approval.

cards.u6-l01-counting-prompt: one… two… three… (count aloud together, one clap per mark)
cards.u6-l02-caregiver-card: Notice — respond — pause. (1) When your baby makes a sound or movement, answer with a short phrase and wait, as if the baby will answer. (2) Copy the sound once, then add the real word. Evening, for yourself only: What did my child 'say' today? What did I say back?
cards.b-l01-message-card: Tomorrow, bring a pencil and one notebook. We start at nine o'clock.
cards.b-l02-story-text: Nwe and her two friends picked 12 mangoes. They want everyone to get a fair share.
cards.a-l01-notice-card: Mobile library van — this week: Tuesday and Thursday, 13:00–16:00, at the market ground. Bring any card you already have. New cards are made on site, free. Issued by: Mayin Township Mobile Library Team (fictional issuer for this practice card), 10 October 2026.
cards.a-l01-forwarded-message-card: "My cousin says the library van comes on Saturday now. Someone told her at the market."
cards.a-l02-timetable-card: Songthaew to Hill Market — weekday mornings (practice card — not a real route) | Leave Padauk Road: 6:10 / 7:30 / 8:50 | Leave Old Gate: 6:25 / 7:45 / 9:05 | Arrive Hill Market: 6:55 / 8:15 / 9:35
cards.a-l02-picture-row-cards: Three cards, one per timetable row, each showing the row's icon (house-road / gate / market-basket) and its three times in large numerals; used instead of the printed table for the non-reading entry.
cards.a-l02-phrase-card: Excuse me — what time does the vehicle go to Hill Market? (choose ครับ/ค่ะ by speaker; the card shows both)
